<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" targetNamespace="https://example.org/bpmn/work-live-austria">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_VisaApplication" name="Visa application"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_RepresentationReply" name="Representation reply"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_AdditionalDocuments" name="Additional documents"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_SupplementarySubmission" name="Supplementary submission"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_WorkLiveAustria" name="Work and Live in Austria">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Applicant" name="Applicant" processRef="Process_WorkLiveAustria"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Representation" name="Competent visa-issuing representation"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Application" name="Submit visa application" sourceRef="Task_SubmitApplication" targetRef="Participant_Representation" messageRef="Message_VisaApplication"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_InitialReply" name="Return application reply" sourceRef="Participant_Representation" targetRef="Task_ReceiveReply" messageRef="Message_RepresentationReply"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_SupplementarySubmission" name="Submit additional documents" sourceRef="Task_SubmitAdditionalDocuments" targetRef="Participant_Representation" messageRef="Message_SupplementarySubmission"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_SupplementaryReply" name="Request or provide further information" sourceRef="Participant_Representation" targetRef="Task_ReceiveSupplementaryReply" messageRef="Message_AdditionalDocuments"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_WorkLiveAustria" name="Work and Live in Austria" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Relocation" name="Plan to work and live in Austria"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_StartParallel" name="Organize in parallel"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_NegotiateAccommodation" name="Negotiate accommodation">
      <bpmn:documentation>Organize accommodation, including negotiation.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_NegotiateBankAccount" name="Negotiate bank account">
      <bpmn:documentation>Organize a bank account, including negotiation.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReviewVisaCycle" name="Review visa / Rot-Weiss-Rot Card cycle">
      <bpmn:documentation>Plan for the visa / Rot-Weiss-Rot Card steps to recur every x months. The description does not specify a numeric interval.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ContactRepresentation" name="Contact representation in advance">
      <bpmn:documentation>Ask the relevant representation for more information, including any additional documents that may be required and its local requirements.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_DetermineCompetentOffice" name="Determine competent representation or office">
      <bpmn:documentation>Generally, visas are issued by representation offices abroad. In specific exceptional cases, certain border control posts may issue them; where extension is permitted, the state police headquarters may handle the extension. For a Schengen visa, use the representation of the country of the main travel destination. If equal time is intended in several countries, determine the main destination based on the length and purpose of the stay; if it cannot be determined, use the country of first entry into the Schengen area. For category A and C applications, territorial competence generally lies with the representation in the consular district of the applicant's legal place of residence. A representation may exceptionally accept an application from a third-country national legally residing but not registered in its district if the applicant justifies applying there. A type D visa must be applied for at the competent Austrian representation; territorial competence for official visa actions is based on the foreign national's place of residence or centre of interest, which may be evidenced by registration forms, a residence permit or a visa. Representation-office addresses, telephone numbers, opening hours and special requirements are available from the Federal Ministry of European and International Affairs (BMEIA).</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CompleteApplicationForm" name="Complete visa application form"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckTravelDocument" name="Check travel document">
      <bpmn:documentation>Check that the travel document is valid in Austria, was issued within the last ten years, has at least two empty pages, and remains valid for at least three months beyond the duration of the visa.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ObtainPhoto" name="Obtain passport photo">
      <bpmn:documentation>Provide a portrait-format passport photo, 35 x 45 mm, meeting the specified passport photo criteria.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ProvideInsurance" name="Provide travel health insurance">
      <bpmn:documentation>Present fully comprehensive travel health insurance for the planned duration of the stay, valid throughout the Schengen area, with cover of at least 30,000 Euro.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ProveMeans" name="Prove sufficient means">
      <bpmn:documentation>Provide proof of sufficient means of subsistence for the intended stay and the return journey to the country of origin or residence.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_GatherOtherEvidence" name="Gather other requested evidence">
      <bpmn:documentation>Provide other evidence requested by the relevant authorities. Depending on location and circumstances, this may include hotel reservations, invitations, booking confirmations, a return flight ticket or proof of gainful employment. Evidence may vary with local standards and coordination with other Schengen representations.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckRefusalGrounds" name="Check for grounds for refusal">
      <bpmn:documentation>Check for other grounds for refusal, including a residence prohibition or an alert issued by a Schengen country.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SubmitApplication" name="Submit visa application"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveReply" name="Receive representation reply"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AdditionalDocuments" name="Additional documents requested?"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ProvideAdditionalDocuments" name="Provide additional documents">
      <bpmn:documentation>Provide any further documents requested by the representation, as applicable.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SubmitAdditionalDocuments" name="Submit additional documents"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveSupplementaryReply" name="Receive further representation reply"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_VisaOutcome" name="Visa outcome?"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_RecordIssued" name="Record visa / card issued"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_RecordNotIssued" name="Record visa / card not issued"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_VisaOutcomeMerge" name="Merge visa outcomes"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_WorkJoin" name="Accommodation, bank and visa steps complete"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_AssistanceComplete" name="Work and live in Austria assistance complete"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_Split" sourceRef="StartEvent_Relocation" targetRef="Gateway_StartParallel"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_Accommodation" sourceRef="Gateway_StartParallel" targetRef="Task_NegotiateAccommodation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_Bank" sourceRef="Gateway_StartParallel" targetRef="Task_NegotiateBankAccount"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_Visa" sourceRef="Gateway_StartParallel" targetRef="Task_ReviewVisaCycle"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Accommodation_Join" sourceRef="Task_NegotiateAccommodation" targetRef="Gateway_WorkJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Bank_Join" sourceRef="Task_NegotiateBankAccount" targetRef="Gateway_WorkJoin"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Review_Contact" sourceRef="Task_ReviewVisaCycle" targetRef="Task_ContactRepresentation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Contact_Office" sourceRef="Task_ContactRepresentation" targetRef="Task_DetermineCompetentOffice"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Office_Form" sourceRef="Task_DetermineCompetentOffice" targetRef="Task_CompleteApplicationForm"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Form_Document" sourceRef="Task_CompleteApplicationForm" targetRef="Task_CheckTravelDocument"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Document_Photo" sourceRef="Task_CheckTravelDocument" targetRef="Task_ObtainPhoto"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Photo_Insurance" sourceRef="Task_ObtainPhoto" targetRef="Task_ProvideInsurance"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Insurance_Means" sourceRef="Task_ProvideInsurance" targetRef="Task_ProveMeans"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Means_Evidence" sourceRef="Task_ProveMeans" targetRef="Task_GatherOtherEvidence"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Evidence_Grounds" sourceRef="Task_GatherOtherEvidence" targetRef="Task_CheckRefusalGrounds"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Grounds_Submit" sourceRef="Task_CheckRefusalGrounds" targetRef="Task_SubmitApplication"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Submit_Reply" sourceRef="Task_SubmitApplication" targetRef="Task_ReceiveReply"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Reply_AdditionalCheck" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveReply" targetRef="Gateway_AdditionalDocuments"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Additional_Yes" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_AdditionalDocuments" targetRef="Task_ProvideAdditionalDocuments">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">additionalDocumentsRequested = true</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Additional_No" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_AdditionalDocuments" targetRef="Gateway_VisaOutcome">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">additionalDocumentsRequested = false</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Provide_SubmitAdditional" sourceRef="Task_ProvideAdditionalDocuments" targetRef="Task_SubmitAdditionalDocuments"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SubmitAdditional_Receive" sourceRef="Task_SubmitAdditionalDocuments" targetRef="Task_ReceiveSupplementaryReply"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReceiveAdditional_Check" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveSupplementaryReply" targetRef="Gateway_AdditionalDocuments"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Outcome_Issued" name="Issued" sourceRef="Gateway_VisaOutcome" targetRef="Task_RecordIssued">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">visaIssued = true</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Outcome_NotIssued" name="Not issued" sourceRef="Gateway_VisaOutcome" targetRef="Task_RecordNotIssued">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">visaIssued = false</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Issued_Merge" sourceRef="Task_RecordIssued" targetRef="Gateway_VisaOutcomeMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotIssued_Merge" sourceRef="Task_RecordNotIssued" targetRef="Gateway_VisaOutcomeMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Visa_Join" sourceRef="Gateway_VisaOutcomeMerge" targetRef="Gateway_WorkJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Join_End" sourceRef="Gateway_WorkJoin" targetRef="EndEvent_AssistanceComplete"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
